FIPS 197 (2023), Section 5.1, Algorithm 1; Section 5.2, Algorithm 2

caption.en: The initial key addition precedes the rounds. Only the final round omits MixColumns; the key schedule supplies every round key.
caption.zh: 初始密钥加位于轮迭代之前；仅末轮省略 MixColumns，轮密钥由密钥扩展生成。

caption.en: A state contains four columns of bytes. Key expansion depends on the key length, including the extra SubWord case for AES-256.
caption.zh: 状态由四列字节组成。密钥扩展随密钥长度变化，AES-256 包含额外的 SubWord 分支。

diagrams.locator: SP 800-67 Rev. 2, Sections 2.1 and 3.1 (historical, withdrawn edition)

caption.en: Three complete DES stages, each with its own key, permutations and 16 Feistel rounds. This is a historical construction, not a deployment recommendation.
caption.zh: 三个完整 DES 阶段各自使用密钥、置换和 16 轮 Feistel 结构。此处展示历史研究对象。

caption.en: The right half enters the expansion, key XOR, S-boxes and permutation. Decryption uses the round keys in reverse order.
caption.zh: 右半部分依次经过扩展、轮密钥异或、S 盒与置换；解密反序使用轮密钥。

diagrams.locator: RFC 8439, Sections 2.1–2.4; IETF 32-bit counter / 96-bit nonce layout

caption.en: Ten column/diagonal double rounds are followed by wordwise feed-forward addition and little-endian serialization. Plaintext is XORed with the resulting keystream.
caption.zh: 十次列轮/对角轮组合后，逐字前馈相加并按小端序输出密钥流，再与明文异或。

caption.en: Each row updates four 32-bit words in order. Boxed plus means addition modulo 2^32; circled plus means XOR; rotations are to the left.
caption.zh: 按顺序更新四个 32 比特字。方框加号表示模 2^32 加法，圆圈加号表示异或，旋转方向为左旋。

caption.en: Padded blocks update the chaining state through compression and feed-forward. Each named instance has its own specified initial value, not just a different output length.
caption.zh: 填充后的分组通过压缩函数与前馈更新链值。每个命名实例采用各自规定的初始值，不只是输出长度不同。

caption.en: A step updates eight working words using the schedule word and round constant. Sigma functions and constants depend on the 32-bit or 64-bit branch.
caption.zh: 每一步结合消息扩展字和轮常量，更新八个工作字。Sigma 函数与常量随 32/64 比特分支变化。

diagrams.locator: FIPS 202, Sections 3, 4, 5.1 and 6.1; SHA-3 suffix 01 before pad10*1

caption.en: Only the rate is XORed with padded input blocks and read for output. The capacity is internal; the permutation always acts on the complete state.
caption.zh: 填充消息仅异或到 rate 部分，输出也仅从该部分读取；capacity 保持内部状态，置换作用于完整状态。

caption.en: Each permutation round applies theta, rho, pi, chi and iota in this order, with 64-bit lanes arranged in a 5 by 5 state.
caption.zh: 64 比特 lane 构成 5×5 状态，每轮按 θ、ρ、π、χ、ι 的顺序更新。

diagrams.locator: FIPS 202, Sections 3, 4, 5.1 and 6.2; SHAKE suffix 1111 before pad10*1

caption.en: SHAKE uses its own domain suffix and a caller-selected output length. Additional output blocks require further permutation calls, without absorbing more input.
caption.zh: SHAKE 使用独立域分离后缀，由调用者指定输出长度；继续输出时再次调用置换，不吸收新的消息。

caption.en: The same 24-round Keccak-f[1600] permutation is used for both SHAKE instances. Their rate and capacity differ.
caption.zh: 两个 SHAKE 实例均使用 24 轮 Keccak-f[1600] 置换，区别在于 rate 与 capacity。

diagrams.locator: FIPS 202, Sections 3.1–3.4, Algorithms 1–7

caption.en: Keccak-p[1600,n] applies round indices 24-n through 23. Its 12-round instance is the last twelve rounds of Keccak-f[1600]. No key is involved.
caption.zh: Keccak-p[1600,n] 使用轮索引 24−n 至 23；12 轮实例对应 Keccak-f[1600] 的最后十二轮。置换本身不使用密钥。

caption.en: Lane coordinates are taken modulo five. Theta mixes column parities, rho rotates lanes, pi relocates them, chi is nonlinear, and iota injects the round constant.
caption.zh: lane 坐标按模五计算。θ 混合列奇偶校验，ρ 旋转 lane，π 重排位置，χ 引入非线性，ι 注入轮常量。

diagrams.locator: SP 800-232 (August 2025), Sections 3 and 4.1.1, Algorithm 3; Appendix A

caption.en: The standardized encryption phases use 12-round initialization/finalization and 8-round intermediate permutations. Empty associated data and the last message block have explicit handling.
caption.zh: 标准化加密采用 12 轮初始化/最终化置换及 8 轮中间置换；空关联数据与最后消息块具有独立处理规则。

caption.en: Five 64-bit state words undergo constant addition, a bit-sliced 5-bit S-box, and word-specific linear diffusion. Bit ordering follows the final NIST edition.
caption.zh: 五个 64 比特状态字经过常量注入、比特切片的 5 比特 S 盒和逐字线性扩散；比特序遵循最终 NIST 版本。

diagrams.locator: RFC 8439, Sections 2.5, 2.6 and 2.8

caption.en: Counter zero derives the one-time Poly1305 key; encryption starts at counter one. The authenticator covers padded AAD, padded ciphertext and their little-endian byte lengths.
caption.zh: 计数器零用于导出一次性 Poly1305 密钥，加密从计数器一开始；认证输入包含填充后的关联数据、密文及小端序字节长度。

caption.en: Padding reaches a multiple of 16 bytes and is empty for an aligned field. Lengths are each encoded as unsigned 64-bit little-endian integers; the tag is 128 bits.
caption.zh: 各字段填充至 16 字节整数倍，已对齐时无需填充；两个长度各以 64 比特无符号小端整数编码，标签长 128 比特。

diagrams.locator: SP 800-38B, Sections 6.1–6.2; full-length AES tags

caption.en: CBC chaining starts at zero. A complete, nonempty last block uses subkey K1; an incomplete or empty last block uses 10* padding and subkey K2.
caption.zh: CBC 链从零开始。非空完整末块使用子密钥 K1；不完整末块或空消息采用 10* 填充并使用 K2。

caption.en: Subkeys are successive doublings of AES_K(0^128) in GF(2^128). The registered instances retain the full 128-bit tag.
caption.zh: 对 AES_K(0^128) 在 GF(2^128) 中连续倍乘生成两个子密钥；当前实例保留完整 128 比特标签。

diagrams.locator: GB/T 32907-2016, Sections 4–7; English description draft-ribose-cfrg-sm4-10, Sections 6–7

caption.en: The four-word state advances through 32 rounds and then reverses word order. Decryption reverses the round-key sequence.
caption.zh: 四字状态经过 32 轮迭代后反序输出；解密反序使用轮密钥。

caption.en: Encryption and key expansion share the byte S-box but use different linear maps: L in the data path and L′ in the key schedule.
caption.zh: 加密与密钥扩展共用字节 S 盒，但分别使用不同的线性变换 L 与 L′。

diagrams.locator: RFC 3713, Sections 2.2–2.4; 18 rounds for 128-bit keys, 24 for 192/256-bit keys

caption.en: Six-round groups are separated by FL/FLINV layers. Whitening surrounds the network; no FL layer follows the last group. The final output swaps the halves.
caption.zh: 每组六轮之间插入 FL/FLINV 层，网络首尾进行密钥白化；最后一组之后不再插入 FL 层，输出交换左右半部。

caption.en: Odd and even Feistel rounds update alternate halves. The keyed FL layer acts on 32-bit words and has an explicitly reversed inverse.
caption.zh: 奇偶 Feistel 轮交替更新左右半部；带密钥的 FL 层作用于 32 比特字，其逆变换反序执行相应操作。

diagrams.locator: RFC 5794, Sections 2.2–2.4

caption.en: Odd and even rounds use different substitution layers. The last round uses SL2 and a final key XOR, omitting the diffusion layer.
caption.zh: 奇偶轮使用不同的替换层。末轮采用 SL2 并增加一次密钥异或，不执行扩散层。

caption.en: The byte substitutions alternate between S-boxes and their inverses. Key expansion derives four 128-bit working words; key length selects constants and round-key count.
caption.zh: 字节替换交替使用 S 盒及其逆。密钥扩展生成四个 128 比特工作字，密钥长度决定常量顺序与轮密钥数量。

diagrams.locator: RFC 4269, Sections 2.1–2.3; corrected specification replacing RFC 4009

caption.en: The first 15 Feistel rounds exchange halves; the final round updates the left half without another exchange. Each round key contains two 32-bit words.
caption.zh: 前 15 个 Feistel 轮交换左右半部，末轮更新左半部而不再交换；每个轮密钥由两个 32 比特字组成。

caption.en: Three G evaluations combine key-mixed right-half words through XOR and modular addition. G consists of byte substitutions and linear mixing.
caption.zh: 右半部与轮密钥混合后，通过异或、模加及三次 G 变换生成轮函数输出；G 包含字节替换与线性混合。

diagrams.locator: Bogdanov et al., PRESENT (CHES 2007), Section 3 and Appendix II

caption.en: Each of the 31 rounds adds a key, applies sixteen 4-bit S-boxes and permutes bits. A final key addition follows the last permutation.
caption.zh: 31 轮各自执行密钥加、十六个 4 比特 S 盒及比特置换；最后一次置换之后再进行一次密钥加。

caption.en: The two instances share the same state transformation. Their key registers differ in width, substituted nibbles and round-counter injection positions.
caption.zh: 两个实例共用状态变换，但密钥寄存器宽度、被替换的半字节和轮计数器注入位置不同。

diagrams.locator: Bernstein, Salsa20 specification (April 27, 2005), Sections 3–6 and 8–10

caption.en: Ten column/row double rounds precede feed-forward and serialization. The original nonce and counter are each 64 bits; the 128-bit-key variant repeats its key with distinct constants.
caption.zh: 十次列轮/行轮组合后执行前馈与序列化。原始 nonce 与计数器均为 64 比特；128 比特密钥实例重复放置密钥并使用独立常量。

caption.en: The four updates use left rotations by 7, 9, 13 and 18 bits. Salsa20 uses column and row tuples, not ChaCha's column and diagonal tuples.
caption.zh: 四次更新依次左旋 7、9、13、18 比特；Salsa20 使用列与行组合，不同于 ChaCha 的列与对角组合。

diagrams.locator: GB/T 32905-2016, Sections 4 and 5.1–5.4

caption.en: Padded 512-bit blocks update eight 32-bit chaining words through 64 steps. Feed-forward uses XOR, not SHA-2's modular addition; the digest is 256 bits.
caption.zh: 填充后的 512 比特消息块经过 64 步，更新八个 32 比特链值字；前馈使用异或而非 SHA-2 的模加，输出 256 比特摘要。

caption.en: The two working-word branches use Wj and W′j. P0 acts in compression; P1 acts in message expansion. Boolean functions change after step 15.
caption.zh: 两条工作字分支分别使用 Wj 与 W′j；P0 用于压缩步骤，P1 用于消息扩展，布尔函数从第 16 步起改变。

caption.en: Five 32-bit words pass through 80 steps per message block and additive feed-forward. SHA-1 is retained as a historical research target; collision resistance is broken.
caption.zh: 五个 32 比特字针对每个消息块执行 80 步并进行加法前馈。SHA-1 作为历史研究对象保留，其抗碰撞性已被攻破。

caption.en: The schedule expands 16 input words into 80 words, including a one-bit rotation absent from SHA-0. Each step rotates and updates the five working words.
caption.zh: 消息扩展将 16 个输入字扩为 80 个字，并包含 SHA-0 所没有的一比特旋转；每一步旋转并更新五个工作字。

diagrams.locator: RFC 1321, Section 3; security context from RFC 6151, Section 2

caption.en: Each 512-bit block updates four 32-bit words in 64 steps, followed by additive feed-forward. MD5 has broken collision resistance and is retained for historical research.
caption.zh: 每个 512 比特消息块经过 64 步更新四个 32 比特字，再进行加法前馈。MD5 的抗碰撞性已被攻破，此处保留用于历史研究。

caption.en: Four groups of 16 steps use different Boolean functions, message-word orders and rotations. Message words, length encoding and digest serialization are little-endian.
caption.zh: 四组各 16 步分别使用不同的布尔函数、消息字顺序和旋转量；消息字、长度编码和摘要序列化均采用小端序。

diagrams.locator: RFC 8017, Sections 7.1 and B.2.1

caption.en: OAEP encoding precedes public RSA exponentiation. Decryption applies private RSA and validates the OAEP encoding; the directory fixes both hashes and the label.
caption.zh: OAEP 编码后执行 RSA 公钥运算；解密执行私钥运算并校验编码。实例明确哈希、MGF1 哈希与标签。

caption.en: SM2 encryption derives a mask from the ephemeral shared point and authenticates the recovered message with SM3. The registered standard profile orders ciphertext components as C1, C3, C2; validation and KDF retry checks are required.
caption.zh: SM2 加密从临时共享点派生掩码，并用 SM3 校验恢复的消息。所列标准实例按 C1、C3、C2 排列密文分量；必须执行验证与 KDF 重试检查。

diagrams.locator: RFC 7919, Appendix A.1

caption.en: The named safe-prime group fixes p and generator 2. Public shares are exchanged before both parties compute the same finite-field secret; authentication and KDF are outside this group definition.
caption.zh: 命名安全素数群确定 p 与生成元 2。交换公开值后，双方计算相同的有限域秘密；身份认证与 KDF 由具体协议规定。

diagrams.locator: SP 800-56A Rev. 3, Section 5.7.1.2; SP 800-186, Section 3.2.1

caption.en: Each party multiplies the peer's validated public point by its private scalar. The registered curves have cofactor one; shared-point encoding, authentication and KDF follow the applicable protocol.
caption.zh: 双方使用私有标量乘以经过验证的对方公钥点。所列曲线余因子为 1；共享点编码、身份认证和 KDF 由相应协议规定。

diagrams.locator: RFC 7748, Sections 5 and 6.1

caption.en: XDH denotes the selected RFC 7748 function, X25519 or X448, including its scalar and coordinate encodings. The result is a raw shared secret, not a complete authenticated exchange.
caption.zh: XDH 表示所选 RFC 7748 函数 X25519 或 X448，含其标量与坐标编码规则。输出是原始共享秘密，不是完整的认证密钥交换。

caption.en: SM2 key exchange combines static and ephemeral keys and derives the output from the shared point and both identity digests. The diagram gives Alice's combination; Bob applies the symmetric rule. Key confirmation is optional in the cited protocol.
caption.zh: SM2 密钥交换结合静态和临时密钥，从共享点及双方身份摘要派生输出。图示 Alice 的组合步骤，Bob 使用对应规则；引用协议中的密钥确认步骤为可选。

diagrams.locator: RFC 8017, Sections 8.1, 9.1 and B.2.1

caption.en: PSS encoding precedes private RSA exponentiation. Verification uses the public key and checks the encoding against the message, including the selected salt length.
caption.zh: PSS 编码后执行 RSA 私钥运算；验签使用公钥并检查消息、编码和所选盐长度。

diagrams.locator: FIPS 186-5, Section 6; SP 800-186, Section 3.2.1

caption.en: ECDSA signs a hash representative using a nonce and private scalar. Verification reconstructs a point with the public key and checks its x-coordinate; range, nonce and point-validation rules remain part of the specification.
caption.zh: ECDSA 使用随机数与私钥标量对哈希代表值签名；验证使用公钥重建点并检查横坐标。取值范围、随机数和点验证规则仍按标准执行。

diagrams.locator: RFC 8032, Sections 4 and 5.1

caption.en: Pure EdDSA derives the nonce and challenge with RFC 8032 domain rules. The overview shows cofactored verification; encoding checks and the variant's exact hash expansion are required. No prehash variant is implied.
caption.zh: Pure EdDSA 按 RFC 8032 的域分离规则生成随机数与挑战。图示带余因子的验证关系；需执行编码检查和对应变体的哈希扩展，不包含预哈希变体。

caption.en: SM2 binds the signer identity and public key through ZA before hashing the message. Its signing and verification equations differ from ECDSA; exceptional scalar values require retry or rejection as specified.
caption.zh: SM2 通过 ZA 绑定签名者身份和公钥，再哈希消息。其签名与验证方程不同于 ECDSA；特殊标量值按规范重试或拒绝。

diagrams.locator: FIPS 204, Sections 5 and 8, Tables 1–2

caption.en: FIPS 204 ML-DSA derives a challenge from a masked module-lattice commitment, checks rejection bounds and encodes the response and hint. Verification reconstructs high bits with the public key and checks the challenge. This is the pure external interface.
caption.zh: FIPS 204 的 ML-DSA 从掩码模格承诺生成挑战，检查拒绝条件并编码响应和提示。验证方使用公钥重建高位并检查挑战；这里采用纯消息外部接口。

diagrams.locator: FIPS 205, Sections 9–11, Table 2

caption.en: FIPS 205 SLH-DSA signs a message digest with FORS and authenticates the FORS public key through an XMSS hypertree. Verification reconstructs the public root. Each instance binds its hash family and forest/hypertree dimensions.
caption.zh: FIPS 205 的 SLH-DSA 使用 FORS 签署消息摘要，并经 XMSS 超树认证 FORS 公钥。验证重建公钥根节点；实例明确哈希家族及森林、超树参数。

diagrams.locator: FIPS 203, Sections 7–8, Tables 2–3

caption.en: FIPS 203 ML-KEM wraps internal encryption with hash-derived coins, re-encryption checking and implicit rejection. The internal encryption component is not exposed as a separate KEM result. Encodings and input checks follow the standard.
caption.zh: FIPS 203 的 ML-KEM 在内部加密外加入哈希派生随机量、重加密检查与隐式拒绝。内部加密组件不作为独立 KEM 结果展示；编码及输入检查遵循标准。
